headline: Growth cools sequentially but margins keep widening
summary_short: Medpace's Q2 2026 revenue was $707.3 million, up 17.2% y/y but roughly flat q/q, while gross margin and operating margin both expanded on higher-margin service mix; net income fell 2.0% q/q to $121.4 million as the effective tax rate rose to 20.0% from about 16% in Q1.
summary_long: Revenue grew 17.2% y/y to $707.3 million, driven by the Metabolic, Oncology, Central Nervous System and AVAI therapeutic areas; Metabolic led at $219.1 million. Direct costs rose on higher reimbursed out-of-pocket expenses and personnel costs, but gross profit expanded faster than revenue, lifting margins q/q and y/y. Net income and EPS dipped slightly q/q despite higher pretax income, as the effective tax rate climbed to 20.0% from roughly 16% in Q1. The company returned $294.7 million via buybacks this quarter, driving cash down 23.0% q/q and equity down 27.5% q/q. No indebtedness at quarter-end. No forward guidance was disclosed.

drivers.explanation: Growth was primarily driven by the Metabolic, Oncology, Central Nervous System and AVAI therapeutic areas versus the prior-year quarter.
Total direct costs rose on higher reimbursed out-of-pocket expenses and higher personnel costs to support growth in service activities, but revenue growth outpaced the cost increase.
Pretax income rose 2.8% q/q, but the effective tax rate climbed to 20.0% from an implied ~16.1% in Q1 2026, pulling net income and EPS down q/q.
Equity fell q/q as the company repurchased $294.7 million of common stock during the quarter, per the equity statement and Item 2 disclosure.
Cash declined q/q because financing activities used $275.7 million (mostly the $294.7 million of buybacks), outpacing the quarter's operating cash generation.
